thread:
Elaine (PM): Quick sync — we need a lightweight routing/feedback model for design partners. Goal: route incoming drift/bug/feature feedback to the right owners without manual triage. Thoughts?
Ravi (Eng): Love this. Need to be explicit about what 'route' means — channel, ticket, or direct DM to owner?
Ashley (ProdOps): For beta scale (20–30 partners) I think automated triage -> GitHub issue + ping owner is fine. Manual only for high-sev.
Morgan (Design): Also want to keep partner sentiment in the loop. Maybe tag type: usability, performance, docs, edge-case.
Elaine (PM): Agreed. Proposal sketch: 1) screening questions during intake to capture expected workflow & integrations; 2) lightweight NLP tagger that maps to our taxonomy; 3) routing map that says: tag -> team owner -> workflow (issue vs DM vs feedback tracker).
Ravi (Eng): For NLP tagger we can start with rule-based keywords + a small ML model later. Keep it opt-in for partners (privacy).
recruit-bot: Reminder: design partner NDAs & data sharing agreements must be accepted before we ingest logs. :lock:
Ashley (ProdOps): Important: routing should respect the partner's preference for contact cadence (weekly summary vs immediate). Add that to intake form.
Elaine (PM): Draft intake fields I want included: name, company, primary contact, priority use-case, expected traffic, can-share-logs (yes/no), preferred contact cadence.
Morgan (Design): Can we add a short prompt to get example prompt+expected output? Helps triage quality regressions.
Ravi (Eng): Implementation note: minimal viable routing config as JSON, e.g.:

```json
{
  "tags": ["usability","latency","accuracy","docs","security"],
  "routes": {
    "latency": {"team": "eng-runtime", "action": "create_issue"},
    "usability": {"team": "product-design", "action": "create_note"}
  }
}
```

Elaine (PM): Nice. For success criteria I propose: (A) mean time to owner-routing < 30m for P1s, < 24h for P2s; (B) partner satisfaction >= 4/5 at 2-week check-in; (C) < 10% false-positive misroutes.
Ashley (ProdOps): How do we measure false-positive misroutes? Need human-in-the-loop labeling for first 6 weeks.
Morgan (Design): We can surface a tiny 'was this routed correctly?' checkbox in the feedback UI — quick yes/no.
Ravi (Eng): For MVP, routing decisions should be logged to a table with: raw_text, predicted_tag, route, timestamp, model_version. We'll need that for audits.
Elaine (PM): Good catch. Also need an 'override' workflow: owner can re-route and that counts as training signal.
recruit-bot: FYI — current DP cohort has 18 partners; 5 consented to share detailed logs.
Ashley (ProdOps): Incentives: offer 3 months of priority support + $500 credit for partners who opt into log sharing. Thoughts?
Morgan (Design): Works. Also offer quicker bug turnarounds as a non-monetary perk.
Ravi (Eng): Roadmap: Week 1: intake form + routing JSON + basic rule-based tagger. Week 2: integrate with GitHub issues and DM pings. Week 3: logging + UI checkbox + metrics.
Elaine (PM): Can we add SLOs to roadmap item owners. Ravi — eng runtime for routing infra. Ashley — intake + partner comms. Morgan — feedback UI. I'll own success metrics and playbook.
Elaine (PM): One edge-case: cross-cutting feedback (e.g., 'model hallucinated and UI made it worse') — routing to product with both eng/design tagged. How to represent that?
Ravi (Eng): Allow multiple tags per item and create linked issues. Avoid duplication by creating a single parent issue with child tasks.
Ashley (ProdOps): For partner-facing comms, draft short copy: "Thanks — your feedback is received. We'll route it to the right team and follow up per your preferred cadence." Keep it < 200 chars.
Morgan (Design): + add micro-survey at 2-week mark: how useful was the response (1-5), did it solve the problem (yes/no).
Elaine (PM): Ok action items: [@Ravi] prototype rule-tagger + logging schema by Tue; [@Ashley] final intake form + consent language by Wed; [@Morgan] mock of feedback checkbox + 2-week micro-survey by Thu. I'll compile the routing map and success metric dashboard.
Ravi (Eng): On it. Will push a prototype gist and link here.
Ashley (ProdOps): I'll start email/text templates for outreach.
Morgan (Design): I'll put mock screenshots into Figma and share. :art: :eyes:
Elaine (PM): If no objections, we'll roll to 5 partners as a canary after internal review next week. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng): +1
Ashley (ProdOps): +1
Morgan (Design): +1
recruit-bot: Note: scheduled follow-up reminder for 7 days.
